cognitive_evolution.new_paradigm: There is a strict bifurcation: search fields (	arget_jobs.experience_years) can be rounded integers for platform margins, while conversational fields (uto_learned_truths, ts_answers) must be injected with nuanced, human-readable strings.

long_term_application: When configuring profiles, always check if a numerical value needs to be rounded for the search algorithm vs. humanized for the LLM prompt. Inject nuanced phrases into uto_learned_truths so the LLM has superior conversational context.
